name: Blex, Vexing Pest // Search for Blex

faces.name: Blex, Vexing Pest
faces.text:
Other Pests, Bats, Insects, Snakes, and Spiders you control get +1/+1.
When Blex dies, you gain 4 life.

faces.name: Search for Blex
faces.text: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put any number of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 3 life for each card you put into your hand this way.
